###### Project general facts

Vistal by Victoria Swarovski is a landmark branded residential development by LEO Developments, introducing the first project of its kind in Oman and the wider GCC. Located in the prestigious Al Mouj Muscat community, the development brings together beachfront living, European-inspired design, and a refined branded lifestyle concept. Designed as an exclusive oceanfront address, Vistal offers a curated collection of residences, including one- and two-bedroom apartments, beach chalets, ocean duplexes, and sky villas, all shaped by a vision of sophisticated coastal living.

The development is centered around a premium lifestyle experience, with over 50 amenities designed to combine leisure, wellness, and everyday convenience. Residents benefit from a wide range of indoor and outdoor facilities, including a wellness center, fitness areas, VIP lounge, children’s play spaces, landscaped outdoor areas, and dedicated leisure zones, all curated to create a seamless beachfront living environment. Positioned within Al Mouj Muscat, Vistal also enjoys close proximity to the marina, beach, luxury hotels, and the wider lifestyle infrastructure of one of Oman’s most established waterfront destinations.

The residences are designed with a calm, contemporary aesthetic, featuring light tones, natural textures, and soft finishes that reflect the surrounding coastal setting. Interiors are finished with high-quality modern materials and carefully planned to create elegant, light-filled living spaces that balance comfort with understated luxury. The project offers a variety of layouts across its apartment and villa-style residences, all crafted to deliver an elevated turnkey lifestyle in a distinctive branded setting.

###### Location description and benefits

Muscat is the capital and main economic center of Oman, known for its unique blend of traditional Arabian culture and modern infrastructure. The city stretches along the coastline of the Arabian Sea and is surrounded by dramatic mountain landscapes, creating a distinctive setting that combines urban comfort with natural beauty. Muscat is recognized for its clean, well-planned environment, high quality of life, and well-planned urban development.

One of the key advantages of Muscat is its developed infrastructure and stable economy. The city offers international schools, modern healthcare facilities, shopping malls, and a growing number of lifestyle and entertainment options. Landmarks such as Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque and the Royal Opera House Muscat reflect the cultural richness of the region, while new residential and commercial developments continue to attract both local and international investors.

From an investment perspective, Muscat is considered one of the most promising real estate markets in the Gulf region. Government initiatives aimed at attracting foreign investment, including property ownership opportunities for non-residents, contribute to its growing appeal. The combination of economic stability, increasing demand for quality housing, and a strategic location makes Muscat an attractive destination for both long-term living and real estate investment.
